description.value: Wisbey Veggies is a beloved roadside farm stand with more than 35 years of history, located just outside the village of Yarrow between Abbotsford and Chilliwack on the Sumas Prairie. The Meredith family grows an extensive range of vegetables on-site and supplements with local fruit, artisan goods, and a u-pick flower field and pumpkin patch. A food truck and picnic tables make it a natural rest stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The site confirms a real, seasonal farm stand operating June–October at 40326 No. 3 Rd, Abbotsford, BC — OSM had no address but the website provides a full one. A food truck is explicitly mentioned ('settle in at our picnic tables with a snack or meal from our NEW food truck'), supporting hot food; fresh homegrown and local produce confirms basic groceries. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cycling amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community is tagged as 'Chilliwack' but the actual mailing address is Abbotsford (40326 No. 3 Rd, Abbotsford, BC V3G 2R6); the business is near Yarrow, between the two cities. The OSM community tag may need correction.
No phone number found in OSM tags or on the website.
Business is seasonal (June–October only); cyclists planning visits outside that window will find it closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible seasonal farm stand with a strong web presence and confirmed produce offerings — a natural stop for cyclists in the Fraser Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Picnic tables confirmed on site. Online shop (Square checkout) available with at least some products (e.g. 10 lb blueberries) offered for pickup.

Basic groceries.detail: Seasonal homegrown vegetables (beets, carrots, peppers, corn, squash, sweet potatoes, etc.), fresh fruit from local growers, and curated local and artisan-made goods available June through October

Hot food.detail: Website mentions 'a snack or meal from our NEW food truck' alongside picnic tables on site
